user.title: Resel FXO gateway
user.description: Connect to the audio_tcp port of the ESP32 gateway. The ESPHome device itself is added by the normal ESPHome integration; this one only carries the voice.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ESP32.
data_description.port: TCP port of the audio_tcp component.
data_description.token: Same value as audio_token in the ESPHome YAML. Leave empty if none is set.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the ESP32 audio port.

init.title: Intercom card audio settings
init.description: Used by every Resel intercom card. Changes reach open cards immediately; a value set in a card's YAML still overrides the one here for that card. Leave a box empty to go back to its default.

data.ptt_timeout: Talk time shown by the timer

data_description.ptt_mode: Hold: talk while the button is pressed. Toggle: tap to start, tap to stop.
data_description.ptt_timeout: Only used by the card's show_timer option; the ESP32 has its own 30 s PTT limit.
data_description.mic_gain: Gain applied to your microphone before it is sent to the line (1 = unchanged).
data_description.mic_echo_cancel: Browser echo cancellation on your microphone.
data_description.mic_noise_suppress: Browser noise suppression on your microphone.
data_description.mic_auto_gain: Browser automatic gain control. Turn the three browser options off if your voice sounds pumped or too quiet.

data_description.gain: Gain of what you hear from the line. Lower it when the leveler is on.
data_description.lowpass_hz: Removes hiss above the voice band (0 = off).
data_description.notch_hz: Narrow notches on this frequency and its multiples: 50 for 50 Hz grids, 60 for 60 Hz, 0 = off.
data_description.notch_max_hz: Highest harmonic that gets a notch.

line_cleaning.name: Line audio: cleaning
line_cleaning.description: Processing order: denoise, noise gate, leveler, then the filters.

data.gate_margin_db: Gate margin above the noise floor

data_description.denoise: Falls back to the plain filters if it cannot load.
data_description.denoise_pregain_db: Raises the level going into RNNoise and lowers it again after it, so a weak line voice is not cut as noise. Try 12-18 dB when words get cut; 0 = off.
data_description.gate: Mutes the line between words; follows the line noise floor by itself.
data_description.gate_margin_db: Raise it if noise leaks through, lower it if word beginnings get cut.
data_description.gate_db: Leave empty for the automatic threshold, or set e.g. -50 to use a fixed one.
data_description.gate_floor_db: Higher is quieter but more abrupt.
data_description.gate_hold_ms: How long the gate stays open after the voice stops.
data_description.leveler: Brings quiet voices up to a constant level, with a soft limiter.
data_description.leveler_max_gain_db: Largest boost the leveler may apply.

options.toggle: Tap to start / tap to stop
